F049.desc: Booth range sold with inverter motors, LED lighting, high-efficiency motors and a choice of heating: diesel (gas-oil), electric resistance, heat recovery, direct-fired gas burner with inverter, and endothermic panels.
features: Diesel: 2-way combustion boiler from 110,000 to 360,000 kcal/h, AISI430 stainless steel; Riello-Roca G40 20 burner; safety thermostat stops the burner on overheating; temperature control by Omron programmer and PT100 probe
Electric resistance: modules of electric resistors heat the forced air passing through them
Heat recovery: recovers part of the energy from the conditioned air inside the cabin through the fan heater unit's ventilation

Direct fired gas burner with inverter: modulating, CE accepted, designed to EN746; close to 100% (stoichiometric) combustion; suited to water-borne paint; high-voltage transformer with electrode; inverter regulates air flow to need

Endothermic panels: radiate heat directly onto the body; lets water-borne paint work in the same time as solvent; temperature controlled by probes; can be fitted to any booth model on the market; no emissions to the atmosphere
